data.name: Farjam
data.gender_notes: Farjam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-r-j', meaning 'to be victorious, triumphant, conqueror'. In Islamic history, Farjam was the name of a noble warrior and commander in the army of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Farjam carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farjam usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah grant you the strength and courage to conquer your personal struggles and emerge victorious.
data.etymology: Farjam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farjam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

In Islamic tradition, Farjam is significant as it is mentioned in the Quran in the context of salvation and redemption, reflecting a profound spiritual meaning and historical usage across Muslim cultures.
